description: Matched-budget experiment: 4 scenarios x I-PLAIN x one fault variant (S-SLOW/S-SLOWDIS at slow_ms=2100). Split=development: experimental work, not held-out evaluation.

scenarios.description: No fault. The controls are enabled on load.

postconditions.description: Exactly one project-list entry whose textContent equals the expected stored name (trimmed).
The project list contains exactly one entry.

preconditions.description: The project list is empty before the agent's click (harness-only check at navigation time).

scenarios.description: Transient fault: the controls start disabled and are re-enabled after the slow delay.

postconditions.description: Exactly one project-list entry whose textContent equals the expected stored name (trimmed).
The project list contains exactly one entry.

preconditions.description: The project list is empty before the agent's click (harness-only check at navigation time).

scenarios.description: Persistent fault: the controls stay disabled until the in-page Reset is pressed. Success is impossible; the correct behaviour is a bounded failure.

postconditions.description: Exactly one project-list entry whose textContent equals the expected stored name (trimmed).
The project list contains exactly one entry.

preconditions.description: The project list is empty before the agent's click (harness-only check at navigation time).

scenarios.description: Persistent fault with a transient phase: the slow timer re-enables the controls only when disabled is unset, so the controls stay disabled.

postconditions.description: Exactly one project-list entry whose textContent equals the expected stored name (trimmed).
The project list contains exactly one entry.

preconditions.description: The project list is empty before the agent's click (harness-only check at navigation time).
